# Gallup News

> > Gallup News delivers polling data, public opinion research, and trend analysis on U.S. politics, economics, healthcare, retirement, and global issues.

Gallup News is the primary news platform for Gallup's public opinion polling and research insights. The site features data-driven reporting on American and global trends, including economic confidence indexes, political priorities, healthcare policy impacts, retirement security, and international surveys through the World Poll.

## Key Topics

- Gallup Economic Confidence Index
- Standard of Living Index
- Social Security
- Medicare
- Medicaid
- retirement planning
- financial security
- public opinion polling
- U.S. economy
- Congress and government politics
- healthcare policy
- small business confidence
- global research
- trend analysis
- economic indexes

## Economic Research & Indexes

- [The Trend Line: U.S. Economic and Standard of Living Indexes Reach New Highs](https://news.gallup.com/video/180458/trend-line-economic-standard-living-indexes-reach-new-highs.aspx): Video report on U.S. Economic Confidence & Standard of Living Index highs
- [Small Business](https://news.gallup.com/topic/small-business.aspx): Small business topic covering entrepreneurship & business confidence trends

## Healthcare & Social Programs

- [Retirement](https://news.gallup.com/topic/retirement.aspx): Retirement topic page covering Social Security, Medicare & financial security
- [The Trend Line: States With Both Medicaid Expansion and State Exchanges Report Biggest Drop in Uninsured Rate](https://news.gallup.com/video/177878/states-medicaid-expansion-state-exchanges-report-biggest-drop-uninsured-rate.aspx): Video on Medicaid expansion impact on state uninsured rates

## Politics & Government

- [The Trend Line: Top Priority for Congress Is to Fix Itself](https://news.gallup.com/video/179198/trend-line-top-priority-congress-fix-itself.aspx): Video analysis of Congressional priorities & political reform needs

## Global Research

- [World in Focus](https://news.gallup.com/topic/world-in-focus.aspx): Global research topic featuring international surveys & worldwide trends
